P.name: Junkyard Titan
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Rumble's''' {{tip|ability|basic ability}} casts generate {{tip|Heat}}, which decays by {{tip|Heat|10 Heat}} per second after not using any basic ability within 4 seconds or ''{{ai|The Equalizer|Rumble}}'' within 2 seconds. '''Rumble's''' mech enters the ''Danger Zone'' when at or above {{tip|Heat|50 Heat}}, and becomes ''Overheated'' while at {{tip|Heat|150 Heat}}.
P.description2: {{sbc|Danger Zone:}} '''Rumble's''' mech enters the ''Danger Zone'', empowering his basic abilities.
P.description3: {{sbc|Overheated:}} '''Rumble's''' mech becomes ''Overheated'', disabling his {{tip|abilities}} as his {{tip|Heat}} decays back down to 0 over 4 seconds. During this time, he gains {{sti|{{as|{{pp|50+((130-50)/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) for 20|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and empowers his {{tip|basic attacks}} to deal {{pp|5 + (40-5)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}} {{as|(+ 4% of the target's '''maximum''' health)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}}. The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at {{pp|65+((150-65)/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) for 20}} against {{tip|monsters}}.

Q.name: Flamespitter
Q.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Rumble''' generates {{tip|Heat|20 Heat}} to activate his flamethrower for 3 seconds, spewing forth flames in a {{tt|frontal|In his facing direction}} cone every {{fd|0.25}} seconds. Enemies hit by the flame are scorched for {{ap|0.5 + 0.1}} seconds, taking {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds as well as upon being hit if not currently scorched, refreshing on subsequent inflictions.

''Flamespitter's'' damage is reduced to {{ap|0.7*100}}% against {{tip|minions}}.
Q.description2:
{{sbc|{{ai|Junkyard Titan 2|Rumble|Danger Zone}} Bonus:}} ''Flamespitter's'' damage is increased by 50%.

''Flamespitter's'' total damage based on the target's health is capped at {{pp|65+((300-65)/17)*(x-1)*(0.7025+0.0175*(x-1)) for 20|formula=Uses stat growth interpolation; 65 base, 300 maximum}} against {{tip|monsters}}.

W.name: Scrap Shield
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rumble''' generates {{tip|Heat|20 Heat}} to grant himself a {{tip|shield}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
W.description2: '''Rumble''' also gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{tt|1 to {{fd|1.32}} seconds.|See notes}}
W.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Junkyard Titan 2|Rumble|Danger Zone}} Bonus:}} ''Scrap Shield's'' shield strength and {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} are increased in effectiveness by 50%.
W.leveling3:
{{st|Enhanced Shield Strength|{{ap|25*1.5 to 145*1.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*1.5}}% AP)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4*1.5}}% of '''maximum''' health)}}}}
{{st|Enhanced Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|10*1.5 to 30*1.5}}%}}

E.name: Electro Harpoon
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rumble''' generates {{tip|Heat|20 Heat}} to shoot a harpoon in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, inflicting them with {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance reduction}}}} for 4 seconds and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for 2 seconds. These effects {{tip|stacks additively|stack additively}} with multiple harpoons, refreshing their duration and stacking up to 2 times.
E.description2: '''Rumble''' periodically [[stocks]] an ''Electro Harpoon'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
E.description3: {{sbc|{{ai|Junkyard Titan 2|Rumble|Danger Zone}} Bonus:}} ''Electro Harpoon's'' effects are increased by 50%.
E.description4: ''If '''Rumble''' casts Electro Harpoon before his mech becomes {{ai|Junkyard Titan 3|Rumble|Overheated}}, he may still use another charge within 3 seconds of the initial cast.''

R.name: The Equalizer
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rumble''' deploys a barrage of rockets from the sky along the target path in a line over {{fd|0.75}} seconds. Each rocket impacts the ground to create a field of fire that lasts {{fd|4.5}} seconds.
R.description2: Enemies struck by the impact or within the field are marked ''Burning'' for 1 second, taking {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds and being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 35%, refreshing while in the area. Enemies may be ''Burning'' for up to 5 seconds, for a total of 20 instances of its effect.
R.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|120/4 to 280/4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35/4}}% AP)}}|Magic Damage per Second|{{ap|120 to 280}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35}}% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|120*5 to 280*5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|35*5}}% AP)}}}}
